kurz: Short means: the pastry breaks tenderly and crumbles in the mouth, because hardly any [[glutenbildung|gluten network]] has formed.
bild_im_kopf: Like sand that only loosely sticks together, rather than chewing gum.
bedeutung: Fat coats the flour before the water comes in. That way the proteins can hardly link up. Little water, cold butter and brief handling keep the pastry short.
was_passiert: Every minute of kneading and every extra splash of water strengthens the network and makes the pastry tough. Resting in the fridge relaxes it and firms up the butter.
faustregeln: Cold butter, press together briefly, do not knead.
